intro.en: Noura tells Salma about a sick little girl and about waste buried in their country that came from factories abroad. Read it and notice how they worry about their people.
intro.ur: Noura, Salma ko ek beemar bachchi aur un ke mulk mein dafn kiye gaye kooday ke bare mein batati hai jo bairoon-e-mulk ki factories se aaya. Parhein aur dekhein ke woh apne logon ke liye kaise fikarmand hain.
intro.ar: تُخْبِرُ نورَةُ سَلْمى عَنْ طِفْلَةٍ مَريضَةٍ وَعَنْ نُفاياتٍ دُفِنَتْ في بَلَدِهِمْ قادِمَةً مِنْ مَصانِعَ في الخارِجِ. اِقْرَأْ وَلاحِظْ كَيْفَ تَخافانِ عَلى أَهْلِهِما.

dialogue.ar: أَنا عائِدَةٌ مِنَ المُسْتَشْفى؛ فَقَدْ زُرْتُ هِنْدَ بِنْتَ جارَتي، وَهِيَ مُصابَةٌ بِالسَّرَطان.
dialogue.tr: anā ʿāʾidatun mina l-mustashfā; faqad zurtu hinda binta jāratī, wahiya muṣābatun bilssaraṭān.
dialogue.en: I am returning from the hospital; I visited Hind, my neighbour's daughter, and she has cancer.
dialogue.ur: Main hospital se wapas aa rahi hoon; main apni padosan ki beti Hind ko dekhne gayi thi, aur use cancer hai.

dialogue.ar: يا لَها مِنْ طِفْلَةٍ مِسْكينَة! كَيْفَ حالَتُها الآن؟
dialogue.tr: yā lahā min ṭiflatin miskīnah! kayfa ḥālatuhā l-ʾān?
dialogue.en: What a poor little girl! How is her condition now?
dialogue.ur: Bechari bachchi! Ab us ki haalat kaisi hai?

dialogue.ar: اِنْتَشَرَ المَرَضُ إِلى أَجْزاءٍ كَثيرَةٍ مِنْ جِسْمِها، وَيَقولُ الأَطِبّاءُ إِنَّ حالَتَها صَعْبَة.
dialogue.tr: intashara l-maraḍu ilā ajzāʾin kathīratin min jismihā, wayaqūlu l-aṭibbāʾu inna ḥālatahā ṣaʿbah.
dialogue.en: The disease has spread to many parts of her body, and the doctors say her condition is difficult.
dialogue.ur: Beemari us ke jism ke kai hisson mein phail gayi hai, aur doctor kehte hain ke us ki haalat mushkil hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ.
dialogue.tr: innā lillahi waʾinnā ilayhi rājiʿūn.
dialogue.en: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
dialogue.ur: Beshak hum Allah ke hain, aur beshak usi ki taraf lautne wale hain.

dialogue.ar: لا أَفْهَمُ لِماذا كَثُرَ المُصابونَ بِهذا المَرَضِ في قَرْيَتِنا؛ الأَمْرُ يُحَيِّرُني.
dialogue.tr: lā afhamu limādhā kathura l-muṣābūna bihdhā l-maraḍi fī qaryatinā; al-amru yuḥayyirunī.
dialogue.en: I do not understand why so many people have become afflicted with this disease in our village; the matter puzzles me.
dialogue.ur: Meri samajh mein nahin aata ke hamare gaon mein is beemari ke itne mareez kyun ho gaye; yeh baat mujhe hairan karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا قَرَأْتُ في الصُّحُفِ أَنَّ نُفاياتٍ مَدْفونَةً وُجِدَتْ قُرْبَ مَدينَتِنا.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā qaraʾtu fī ṣ-ṣuḥufi anna nufāyātin madfūnatan wujidat qurba madīnatinā.
dialogue.en: And I read in the newspapers that buried waste was found near our city.
dialogue.ur: Aur maine akhbaron mein parha ke hamare shehar ke qareeb dafn kiya hua kooda mila hai.

dialogue.ar: نُفايات؟ وَمِنْ أَيْنَ أَتَتْ؟
dialogue.tr: nufāyāt? wamin ayna atat?
dialogue.en: Waste? And where did it come from?
dialogue.ur: Kooda? Aur woh kahan se aaya?

dialogue.ar: كَتَبَتِ الصُّحُفُ أَنَّها جاءَتْ بِالسُّفُنِ مِنْ بَعْضِ الدُّوَلِ الصِّناعِيَّةِ لِتُدْفَنَ عِنْدَنا.
dialogue.tr: katabati ṣ-ṣuḥufu annahā jāʾat bilssufuni min baʿḍi d-duwali ṣ-ṣināʿiyyati litudfana ʿindanā.
dialogue.en: The newspapers wrote that it came by ships from some industrial countries to be buried with us.
dialogue.ur: Akhbaron ne likha ke yeh jahazon ke zariye kuch sanati mulkon se aaya taake hamare haan dafn ho.

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا لا يَدْفِنونَها في أَراضيهِمْ هُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: walimādhā lā yadfinūnahā fī arāḍīhim hum?
dialogue.en: And why do they not bury it in their own lands?
dialogue.ur: Aur woh ise apni zameenon mein kyun dafn nahin karte?

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّ عِنْدَهُمْ مُنَظَّماتٍ تَمْنَعُ ذلِكَ، وَهُمْ يَخافونَ عَلى شُعوبِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: liʾanna ʿindahum munaẓẓamātin tamnaʿu dhālik, wahum yakhāfūna ʿalā shuʿūbihim.
dialogue.en: Because they have organizations that prevent that, and they fear for their peoples.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke un ke paas aisi tanzeemein hain jo isse rokti hain, aur woh apni qaumon ke liye fikarmand hain.

dialogue.ar: وَنَحْنُ؟ أَلا نَخافُ عَلى أَهْلِنا وَأَطْفالِنا مِثْلَهُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: wanaḥn? alā nakhāfu ʿalā ahlinā waʾaṭfālinā mithlahum?
dialogue.en: And us? Do we not fear for our families and children like them?
dialogue.ur: Aur hum? Kya hum apne ghar walon aur bachchon ke liye un ki tarah fikarmand nahin?

dialogue.ar: بَلى، يَجِبُ أَنْ نُنْشِئَ مُنَظَّماتٍ تَحْمي بَلَدَنا وَصِحَّةَ شَعْبِنا.
dialogue.tr: balā, yajibu an nunshiʾa munaẓẓamātin taḥmī baladanā waṣiḥḥata shaʿbinā.
dialogue.en: Yes; we must found organizations that protect our country and the health of our people.
dialogue.ur: Zaroor; hamein aisi tanzeemein banani chahiye jo hamare mulk aur hamare logon ki sehat ki hifazat karein.

dialogue.ar: هذا ما يَجِبُ أَنْ نَبْدَأَ بِهِ، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā mā yajibu an nabdaʾa bih, in shāʾa llāh.
dialogue.en: This is what we must start with, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Hamein isi se shuru karna chahiye, insha'Allah.

vocab.ur: kisi ke liye fikarmand hota hai

q.ur: Hind ko kya beemari hai?

q.ur: «إِنّا لِلّهِ وَإِنّا إِلَيْهِ راجِعونَ» yahan kis cheez ko zahir karta hai?

I like this matter / Mujhe yeh pasand hai

title.ur: Aawazein: Noon ka Meem ban jana

intro.en: When a silent noon (نْ) or tanween comes before the letter ب (ba), it is pronounced like م (meem). Example: أَنْبَتَ is said 'ambata'. Listen to the Qur'an examples in the book and notice it.
intro.ur: Jab noon saakin (نْ) ya tanween harf ب se pehle aaye to woh م (meem) ki tarah parha jata hai. Misal: أَنْبَتَ ko 'ambata' parhte hain. Kitab ki Qur'ani misalon ko sun kar dekhein.
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَتْ نونٌ ساكِنَةٌ أَوْ تَنْوينٌ قَبْلَ حَرْفِ الباءِ فَإِنَّها تُنْطَقُ ميماً. مِثالٌ: «أَنْبَتَ» تُنْطَقُ «أَمْبَتَ». اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى أَمْثِلَةِ القُرْآنِ في الكِتابِ وَلاحِظْ ذلِكَ.

q.en: Before which letter does a silent noon turn into meem?
q.ur: Noon saakin kis harf se pehle meem ban jata hai?
q.ar: قَبْلَ أَيِّ حَرْفٍ تَنْقَلِبُ النّونُ السّاكِنَةُ ميماً؟

q.en: Which also turns into meem before ب?
q.ur: Ba se pehle aur kya meem ban jata hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَنْقَلِبُ أَيْضاً ميماً قَبْلَ الباءِ؟

q.en: How is «مِنْ بَعْد» pronounced when the noon turns into meem?
q.ur: «مِنْ بَعْد» ko noon meem banne par kaise parhte hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تُنْطَقُ «مِنْ بَعْد» عِنْدَ قَلْبِ النّونِ ميماً؟

q.ur: Qaida mukhtasar:

intro.en: If a verb has a weak letter (و or ي or ى) at its start, middle or end, that letter is dropped when making the command. Example: قالَ (he said) becomes قُلْ (say!). Another: وَعَدَ becomes عِدْ (promise!).
intro.ur: Agar fe'l mein harf-e-illat (و، ي، ى) shuru, beech ya akhir mein ho to hukm banate waqt woh harf gir jata hai. Misal: قالَ (usne kaha) se قُلْ (kaho!). Aur وَعَدَ se عِدْ (wada karo!).
intro.ar: إِذا كانَ في الفِعْلِ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ (و أَوْ ي أَوْ ى) في أَوَّلِهِ أَوْ وَسَطِهِ أَوْ آخِرِهِ، يُحْذَفُ عِنْدَ صِياغَةِ الأَمْرِ. مِثالٌ: «قالَ» تُصْبِحُ «قُلْ»، وَ«وَعَدَ» تُصْبِحُ «عِدْ».

q.en: What is the command of قالَ?
q.ur: قالَ ka hukm kya hai?

q.ur: نامَ ka hukm?

q.en: What is the command of قَضى?
q.ur: قَضى ka hukm?

intro.en: Listen to a news item about a city that bought new buses to reduce pollution, then answer questions. After that, practise asking your partner about the environment.
intro.ur: Ek khabar sunein jis mein ek shehar ne mahol ki hifazat ke liye nayi bussein khareedeen, phir sawalon ke jawab dein. Uske baad apne saathi se mahol ke baare mein sawal jawab karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنْ مَدينَةٍ اِشْتَرَتْ حافِلاتٍ جَديدَةً لِتَقْليلِ التَّلَوُّثِ، ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ اِسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنِ البيئَةِ.

q.en: Which country is the news about?
q.ur: Khabar kis mulk ki hai?

q.en: What problem does the city face?
q.ur: Shehar ko kya masla hai?

q.en: How many buses did the council buy?
q.ur: Council ne kitni bussein khareedeen?

q.en: What do the new buses run on?
q.ur: Nayi bussein kis par chalti hain?

q.en: How do you ask a partner: do you live in the city or the countryside?
q.ur: Saathi se poochein: shehar mein rehte ho ya dehaat mein?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ زَميلَكَ: هَلْ تَعيشُ في المَدينَةِ أَمْ في الرِّيفِ؟

options: هَلْ تَعيشُ في المَدينَةِ أَمْ في الرِّيف؟

intro.en: This reading explains four kinds of pollution: air, water, soil and noise. For each, it gives the cause and the harm to people, animals and plants.
intro.ur: Is parhai mein aloodgi ki chaar qismein hain: hawa, paani, mitti aur shor. Har ek ka sabab aur insaan, janwar aur paudhon ko nuqsan bataya gaya hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ يَشْرَحُ أَرْبَعَةَ أَنْواعٍ مِنَ التَّلَوُّثِ: الهَواءِ وَالماءِ وَالتُّرْبَةِ وَالضَّوْضاءِ. وَيَذْكُرُ لِكُلِّ نَوْعٍ سَبَبَهُ وَضَرَرَهُ عَلى الإِنْسانِ وَالحَيَوانِ وَالنَّباتِ.

dialogue.ar: لِلتَّلَوُّثِ في بيئَتِنا أَنْواعٌ عَديدَةٌ، أَشْهَرُها تَلَوُّثُ الهَواءِ وَالماءِ وَالتُّرْبَةِ، ثُمَّ الضَّوْضاء.
dialogue.tr: lilttalawwuthi fī bīʾatinā anwāʿun ʿadīdah, ashharuhā talawwuthu l-hawāʾi wālmāʾi wāltturbah, thumma ḍ-ḍawḍāʾ.
dialogue.en: Pollution in our environment has many kinds; the best known are pollution of air, water and soil, then noise.
dialogue.ur: Hamare mahol mein aloodgi ki bohat si qismein hain; sab se mashhoor hawa, paani aur mitti ki aloodgi hain, phir shor.

dialogue.ar: في تَلَوُّثِ الهَواءِ تَظْهَرُ في الجَوِّ رائِحَةٌ كَريهَةٌ وَلَوْنٌ داكِنٌ، وَالهَواءُ النَّقِيُّ لا لَوْنَ لَهُ وَلا رائِحَة.
dialogue.tr: fī talawwuthi l-hawāʾi taẓharu fī l-jawwi rāʾiḥatun karīhatun walawnun dākin, wālhawāʾu n-naqiyyu lā lawna lahu walā rāʾiḥah.
dialogue.en: In air pollution an unpleasant smell and a dark colour appear in the atmosphere, while clean air has no colour and no smell.
dialogue.ur: Hawa ki aloodgi mein fiza mein badbu aur gehra rang zahir hota hai, jabke saaf hawa ka na rang hota hai na boo.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَسْبابِهِ حَرْقُ الوَقودِ وَالنِّفْطِ في مُحَرِّكاتِ السَّيّاراتِ وَالمَصانِع.
dialogue.tr: wamin asbābihi ḥarqu l-waqūdi wālnnifṭi fī muḥarrikāti s-sayyārāti wālmaṣāniʿ.
dialogue.en: Among its causes is burning fuel and oil in the engines of cars and factories.
dialogue.ur: Is ke asbaab mein gaariyon aur karkhanon ke engines mein eendhan aur tel ka jalna shamil hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ يَضُرُّ بِالرِّئَةِ وَالعُيونِ، وَيُسَبِّبُ مَوْتَ كَثيرٍ مِنَ الحَيَواناتِ وَالنَّباتات.
dialogue.tr: wahuwa yaḍurru bilrriʾati wālʿuyūn, wayusabbibu mawta kathīrin mina l-ḥayawānāti wālnnabātāt.
dialogue.en: It harms the lungs and eyes, and causes the death of many animals and plants.
dialogue.ur: Yeh phephron aur aankhon ko nuqsan pahunchata hai, aur bohat se janwaron aur paudhon ki maut ka sabab banta hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا تَلَوُّثُ الماءِ فَيَجْعَلُ الماءَ العَذْبَ أَقَلَّ، وَهُوَ الماءُ الَّذي نَشْرَبُهُ وَنَغْسِلُ بِه.
dialogue.tr: ammā talawwuthu l-māʾi fayajʿalu l-māʾa l-ʿadhba aqall, wahuwa l-māʾu illadhī nashrabuhu wanaghsilu bih.
dialogue.en: As for water pollution, it makes fresh water less, and that is the water we drink and wash with.
dialogue.ur: Rahi paani ki aloodgi, to woh meetha paani kam kar deti hai, aur yehi woh paani hai jo hum peete aur jis se dhote hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالسَّبَبُ أَنَّ النّاسَ يُلْقونَ في البِحارِ وَالأَنْهارِ وَالآبارِ مَوادَّ كيماوِيَّةً وَنُفاياتٍ وَمِياهَ صَرْفٍ صِحِّيٍّ.
dialogue.tr: wālssababu anna n-nāsa yulqūna fī l-biḥāri wālʾanhāri wālʾābāri mawādda kīmāwiyyatan wanufāyātin wamīha ṣarfin ṣiḥḥiyy.
dialogue.en: The cause is that people throw chemicals, waste and sewage water into seas, rivers and wells.
dialogue.ur: Wajah yeh hai ke log samandaron, nadiyon aur kunon mein kimyai maade, kooda aur gandagi ka paani daal dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتَلَوُّثُ التُّرْبَةِ يُتْلِفُ الأَرْضَ الصّالِحَةَ لِلزِّراعَةِ، فَنَفْقِدُ جُزْءاً مِنَ الأَرْضِ الَّتي تُنْبِتُ طَعامَنا وَطَعامَ الحَيَوان.
dialogue.tr: watalawwuthu t-turbati yutlifu l-arḍa ṣ-ṣāliḥata lilzzirāʿah, fanafqidu juzʾan mina l-arḍi illatī tunbitu ṭaʿāmanā waṭaʿāma l-ḥayawān.
dialogue.en: Soil pollution spoils land fit for farming, so we lose a part of the land that grows our food and the food of animals.
dialogue.ur: Mitti ki aloodgi qabil-e-kasht zameen ko kharab kar deti hai, yoon hum us zameen ka ek hissa kho dete hain jo hamara aur janwaron ka khana ugati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالضَّوْضاءُ كَثيرَةٌ في المُدُنِ بِسَبَبِ وَسائِلِ النَّقْلِ، وَتَضُرُّ بِالسَّمْعِ وَتُسَبِّبُ القَلَق.
dialogue.tr: wālḍḍawḍāʾu kathīratun fī l-muduni bisababi wasāʾili n-naql, wataḍurru bilssamʿi watusabbibu l-qalaq.
dialogue.en: Noise is common in cities because of means of transport, and it harms hearing and causes anxiety.
dialogue.ur: Shehron mein nqal-o-harkat ke zara'i ki wajah se shor bohat hota hai, aur yeh sama'at ko nuqsan deta hai aur bechaini paida karta hai.

q.en: Which is one of the types mentioned?
q.ur: Inmein se kaun si qism zikr hui?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَوْعٍ مِنْ أَنْواعِ التَّلَوُّثِ ذُكِرَ في النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is a cause of air pollution?
q.ur: Hawa ki aloodgi ka sabab?

q.en: Water pollution is caused by...
q.ur: Paani ki aloodgi ka sabab...

q.en: Noise (الضَّوْضاء) leads to...
q.ur: Shor ka nateeja...

q.en: Soil pollution causes...
q.ur: Mitti ki aloodgi se...

intro.en: A noun or verb in the 'raf' state' shows it with a sign at its end. There are four signs: the damma, the alif, the waw and the staying of the noon. Which one depends on the word type.
intro.ur: Ism ya fe'l jab marfoo' hota hai to akhir mein nishani hoti hai. Chaar nishaniyan: zamma, alif, waw aur noon ka sabit rehna. Kaun si ho, yeh lafz ki qism par hai.
intro.ar: يَظْهَرُ رَفْعُ الاِسْمِ أَوِ الفِعْلِ بِعَلامَةٍ في آخِرِهِ. لِلرَّفْعِ أَرْبَعُ عَلاماتٍ: الضَّمَّةُ وَالأَلِفُ وَالواوُ وَثُبوتُ النّونِ، وَتَخْتَلِفُ بِاخْتِلافِ نَوْعِ الكَلِمَةِ.

q.en: Which five-nouns example is shown?
q.ur: Asma-e-khamsa ki kaun si misal hai?

title.en: Who protects the environment? Who harms it?
title.ur: Mahol ki hifazat kaun karta hai? Kaun bigadta hai?

intro.en: Tariq invites Mazin to join an organization for protecting the environment. They go on a tour and see people who harm nature and others who protect it.
intro.ur: Tariq, Mazin ko mahol ki hifazat ki ek tanzeem mein shamil hone ki dawat deta hai. Woh ek daura karte hain aur kuch logon ko fitrat bigaarte aur kuch ko us ki hifazat karte dekhte hain.
intro.ar: يَدْعو طارِقٌ مازِناً لِيَشْتَرِكَ في مُنَظَّمَةٍ لِحِمايَةِ البيئَةِ. يَقومونَ بِجَوْلَةٍ، فَيَرَوْنَ ناساً يُفْسِدونَ الطَّبيعَةَ وَآخَرينَ يَحْمونَها.

dialogue.ar: وَضَعَ أَصْدِقائي خُطَّةً لِإِنْشاءِ مُنَظَّمَةٍ تُدافِعُ عَنِ البيئَةِ، فَهَلْ تَشْتَرِكُ مَعَهُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: waḍaʿa aṣdiqāʾī khuṭṭatan liʾinshāʾi munaẓẓamatin tudāfiʿu ʿani l-bīʾah, fahal tashtariku maʿahum?
dialogue.en: My friends made a plan to found an organization that defends the environment; will you join them?
dialogue.ur: Mere doston ne mahol ka difa karne wali tanzeem banane ka mansooba banaya hai; kya aap un ke saath shamil honge?

dialogue.ar: بِالطَّبْعِ أُوافِق! وَطَنُنا في حاجَةٍ إِلى مَنْ يَحْميهِ.
dialogue.tr: bilṭṭabʿi ūfiq! waṭanunā fī ḥājatin ilā man yaḥmīh.
dialogue.en: Of course I agree! Our homeland needs someone to protect it.
dialogue.ur: Zaroor, main raazi hoon! Hamare watan ko aise logon ki zaroorat hai jo us ki hifazat karein.

dialogue.ar: غَداً، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ، نَقومُ بِجَوْلَةٍ بِالطّائِرَةِ فَوْقَ البِلادِ، لِنَرى كَيْفَ يَتَصَرَّفُ النّاسُ مَعَ الطَّبيعَة.
dialogue.tr: ghadan, in shāʾa llāh, naqūmu bijawlatin bilṭṭāʾirati fawqa l-bilād, linarā kayfa yataṣarrafu n-nāsu maʿa ṭ-ṭabīʿah.
dialogue.en: Tomorrow, God willing, we will go on a tour by plane over the country, to see how people treat nature.
dialogue.ur: Kal, insha'Allah, hum jahaz mein mulk ke upar ka daura karenge, taake dekhein ke log fitrat ke saath kaisa sulook karte hain.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ رائِعَة، سَأَكونُ مَعَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: fikratun rāʾiʿah, saʾakūnu maʿakum.
dialogue.en: A wonderful idea; I will be with you.
dialogue.ur: Bahut umda khayal hai; main aap ke saath hoon.

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُروا إِلى هُناكَ؛ ناسٌ يَعْبَثونَ بِالطَّبيعَةِ وَيُفْسِدونَها!
dialogue.tr: unẓurū ilā hunāk; nāsun yaʿbathūna bilṭṭabīʿati wayufsidūnahā!
dialogue.en: Look over there; people are tampering with nature and spoiling it!
dialogue.ur: Wahan dekhiye; log fitrat se khilwar kar ke use bigaad rahe hain!

dialogue.ar: أَحَدُهُمْ يُحْرِقُ الغابَةَ، وَآخَرُ يَقْتُلُ الحَيَواناتِ البَرِّيَّةَ بِلا سَبَب!
dialogue.tr: aḥaduhum yuḥriqu l-ghābah, waʾākharu yaqtulu l-ḥayawānāti l-barriyyata bilā sabab!
dialogue.en: One of them burns the forest, and another kills wild animals for no reason!
dialogue.ur: Un mein se ek jungle jalata hai, aur doosra bila wajah jangli janwaron ko maarta hai!

dialogue.ar: هؤُلاءِ يَتْرُكونَ القُمامَةَ حَوْلَ الطُّرُقِ، وَأُولئِكَ يَرْمونَ المُخَلَّفاتِ في مِياهِ البَحْر.
dialogue.tr: hāʾulāʾi yatrukūna l-qumāmata ḥawla ṭ-ṭuruq, waʾūlʾika yarmūna l-mukhallafāti fī mīhi l-baḥr.
dialogue.en: These leave rubbish around the roads, and those throw their waste into the sea water.
dialogue.ur: Yeh log sadakon ke ird-gird kooda chhor dete hain, aur woh log apna kachra samandar ke paani mein phenk dete hain.

dialogue.ar: الفَسادُ ظاهِرٌ في البَرِّ وَالبَحْرِ؛ لِماذا يَفْعَلُ النّاسُ هذا؟
dialogue.tr: al-fasādu ẓāhirun fī l-barri wālbaḥr; limādhā yafʿalu n-nāsu hādhā?
dialogue.en: The harm is visible on land and sea; why do people do this?
dialogue.ur: Khushki aur samandar mein bigaad nazar aa raha hai; log aisa kyun karte hain?

dialogue.ar: اُنْظُروا الآنَ إِلى جَماعَةٍ أُخْرى، إِنَّها تُحافِظُ عَلى الطَّبيعَةِ بِإِخْلاص.
dialogue.tr: unẓurū l-ʾāna ilā jamāʿatin ukhrā, innahā tuḥāfiẓu ʿalā ṭ-ṭabīʿati biʾikhlāṣ.
dialogue.en: Now look at another group; it preserves nature sincerely.
dialogue.ur: Ab ek aur jamaat ko dekhiye; woh ikhlas se fitrat ki hifazat karti hai.

dialogue.ar: هُمْ يَغْرِسونَ الأَشْجارَ في الصَّحْراءِ حَتّى يَمْنَعوا التَّصَحُّر.
dialogue.tr: hum yaghrisūna l-ashjāra fī ṣ-ṣaḥrāʾi ḥattā yamnaʿū t-taṣaḥḥur.
dialogue.en: They plant trees in the desert to prevent desertification.
dialogue.ur: Woh registan mein darakht lagate hain taake registan ka phailna ruk jaye.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا هؤُلاءِ فَيَرْعَوْنَ الطُّيورَ وَالحَيَواناتِ الَّتي صارَتْ نادِرَةً خَوْفاً عَلَيْها مِنَ الاِنْقِراض.
dialogue.tr: ammā hāʾulāʾi fayarʿawna ṭ-ṭuyūra wālḥayawānāti illatī ṣārat nādiratan khawfan ʿalayhā mina l-inqirāḍ.
dialogue.en: As for these, they look after birds and animals that have become rare, fearing for them from extinction.
dialogue.ur: Rahe yeh log, to woh parindon aur un janwaron ki dekh-bhaal karte hain jo nayab ho gaye hain, un ke khatam hone ke dar se.

dialogue.ar: يُسْعِدُني ما يَقومُ بِهِ هؤُلاءِ، فَهُوَ عَمَلٌ طَيِّب.
dialogue.tr: yusʿidunī mā yaqūmu bihi hāʾulāʾi, fahuwa ʿamalun ṭayyib.
dialogue.en: What these people are doing makes me happy; it is a good deed.
dialogue.ur: In logon ka kaam mujhe khushi deta hai; yeh nek amal hai.

dialogue.ar: حُلْمُنا بيئَةٌ نَظيفَةٌ خالِيَةٌ مِنَ التَّلَوُّثِ وَالدُّخان.
dialogue.tr: ḥulmunā bīʾatun naẓīfatun khāliyatun mina t-talawwuthi wālddukhān.
dialogue.en: Our dream is a clean environment free from pollution and smoke.
dialogue.ur: Hamara khwab ek saaf mahol hai jo aloodgi aur dhuen se paak ho.

dialogue.ar: رِسالَتُنا لِلنّاسِ واضِحَةٌ، وَنَسْأَلُ اللهَ التَّوْفيق.
dialogue.tr: risālatunā lilnnāsi wāḍiḥah, wanasʾalu llāh t-tawfīq.
dialogue.en: Our message to people is clear, and we ask Allah for success.
dialogue.ur: Logon ke liye hamara paigham wazeh hai, aur hum Allah se tawfeeq maangte hain.

q.en: What did Tariq's friends create?
q.ur: Tariq ke doston ne kya banaya?

q.en: How will they travel on the tour?
q.ur: Daure par kaise jayenge?

q.en: What is the first group doing?
q.ur: Pehla guroh kya kar raha hai?

q.en: Why does the second group plant the land?
q.ur: Doosra guroh zameen kyun ugata hai?

q.en: What is the organization's message, in the end?
q.ur: Tanzeem ka paigham aakhir mein?

intro.en: First practise the vocabulary words of the dialogue in your own sentences. Then learn the signs of nasb: the fatha, the kasra, the ya, the alif and dropping the noon.
intro.ur: Pehle sabaq ke alfaaz apne jumlon mein istemal karein. Phir nasb ki nishaniyan seekhein: fatha, kasra, ya, alif aur noon ka girna.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ أَوَّلاً عَلى كَلِماتِ الحِوارِ في جُمَلٍ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ. ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمْ عَلاماتِ النَّصْبِ: الفَتْحَةُ وَالكَسْرَةُ وَالياءُ وَالأَلِفُ وَحَذْفُ النّونِ.

title.ur: Sun kar samajhna: Mausam ki tabdeeli

intro.en: Listen to a news item about the earth getting hotter. Then complete sentences about the biggest problem, deaths, migration and what rising heat may lead to. The second slide is a team activity: compare what harms and what protects the environment.
intro.ur: Zameen ke garam hone ki khabar sunein aur jumle mukammal karein. Dusri slide team ka kaam hai: mahol ko bigadne wale aur bachane wale aamal ka muqabala karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنِ اِرْتِفاعِ حَرارَةِ الأَرْضِ، ثُمَّ أَكْمِلْ جُمَلاً عَنْ أَكْبَرِ مُشْكِلَةٍ وَالوَفَياتِ وَالهِجْرَةِ وَما قَدْ يُؤَدّي إِلَيْهِ اِرْتِفاعُ الحَرارَةِ. وَالنَّشاطُ الثّاني جَماعِيٌّ: قارِنْ بَيْنَ ما يَضُرُّ بِالبيئَةِ وَما يَحْميها.

q.en: What is the topic of the news?
q.ur: Khabar ka mauzoo?

q.en: Which action harms the environment?
q.ur: Kaun sa amal mahol ko nuqsan deta hai?

q.en: Which action protects the environment?
q.ur: Kaun sa amal mahol ki hifazat hai?

q.en: What is the Arabic for 'change of climate'?
q.ur: 'Mausam ki tabdeeli' arabi mein?
q.ar: ما العِبارَةُ الدّالَّةُ عَلى تَغَيُّرِ المُناخِ؟

intro.en: A reading about how Islam encourages protecting the environment: planting trees and not wasting water. The book quotes the Prophet ﷺ about planting a small palm shoot. Read it with respect.
intro.ur: Ek parhai ke Islam mahol ki hifazat kaise sikhata hai: darakht lagana aur paani zaya na karna. Kitab Nabi ﷺ ki hadees naqal karti hai. Adab se parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ تَشْجيعِ الإِسْلامِ عَلى حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ: غَرْسِ الأَشْجارِ وَعَدَمِ الإِسْرافِ في الماءِ. وَيَذْكُرُ الكِتابُ حَديثَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنْ غَرْسِ الفَسيلَةِ. اِقْرَأْهُ بِاحْتِرامٍ.

dialogue.ar: نَعيشُ في بيئَةٍ جَميلَةٍ، وَمِنْ واجِبِنا أَنْ نَعْتَنِيَ بِها وَلا نُفْسِدَها، فَهِيَ نِعْمَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ أَنْعَمَ اللهُ بِها عَلَيْنا.
dialogue.tr: naʿīshu fī bīʾatin jamīlah, wamin wājibinā an naʿtaniya bihā walā nufsidahā, fahiya niʿmatun kabīratun anʿama llāh bihā ʿalaynā.
dialogue.en: We live in a beautiful environment, and it is our duty to take care of it and not spoil it, for it is a great blessing with which Allah has favoured us.
dialogue.ur: Hum ek khoobsurat mahol mein rehte hain, aur hamara farz hai ke us ka khayal rakhein aur use na bigarein, kyunke yeh ek bari nemat hai jo Allah ne hum par ki hai.

dialogue.ar: وَفي بِلادٍ كَثيرَةٍ اليَوْمَ مُنَظَّماتٌ تَعْمَلُ لِحِمايَةِ البيئَةِ وَتُنَبِّهُ النّاسَ إِلى خَطَرِ التَّلَوُّث.
dialogue.tr: wafī bilādin kathīratin l-yawma munaẓẓamātun taʿmalu liḥimāyati l-bīʾati watunabbihu n-nāsa ilā khaṭari t-talawwuth.
dialogue.en: In many countries today there are organizations that work to protect the environment and warn people of the danger of pollution.
dialogue.ur: Aaj bohat se mulkon mein aisi tanzeemein hain jo mahol ki hifazat ke liye kaam karti hain aur logon ko aloodgi ke khatre se agah karti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَعْمالِها: بَيانُ أَخْطارِ التَّلَوُّثِ، وَمُراقَبَةُ الحُكوماتِ وَالمُؤَسَّساتِ، وَاقْتِراحُ وَسائِلِ المُحافَظَة.
dialogue.tr: wamin aʿmālihā: bayānu akhṭāri t-talawwuth, wamurāqabatu l-ḥukūmāti wālmuʾassasāt, wāqtirāḥu wasāʾili l-muḥāfaẓah.
dialogue.en: Among their work: explaining the dangers of pollution, monitoring governments and institutions, and suggesting ways of preservation.
dialogue.ur: Un ke kaamon mein aloodgi ke khataraat ka bayan, hukumaton aur idaron ki nigrani, aur hifazat ke tareeqon ki tajaweez shamil hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَحُثُّ الإِسْلامُ عَلى غَرْسِ الأَشْجارِ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ وَسائِلِ المُحافَظَةِ عَلى البيئَةِ، وَيَعُدُّ إِحْراقَ الغاباتِ خَطَأً.
dialogue.tr: wayaḥuththu l-islāmu ʿalā gharsi l-ashjāri wahuwa min afḍali wasāʾili l-muḥāfaẓati ʿalā l-bīʾah, wayaʿuddu iḥrāqa l-ghābāti khaṭaʾan.
dialogue.en: Islam urges planting trees, which is one of the best ways of preserving the environment, and counts burning forests a mistake.
dialogue.ur: Islam darakht lagane par ubharta hai, jo mahol ki hifazat ke behtareen tareeqon mein se hai, aur jungle jalane ko ghalti qarar deta hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «إِنْ قامَتِ القِيامَةُ، وَفي يَدِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَسيلَةٌ (نَخْلَةٌ صَغيرَةٌ) فَإِنِ اسْتَطاعَ أَلّا تَقومَ حَتّى يَغْرِسَها، فَلْيَغْرِسْها».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: in qāmati l-qiyāma, wa fī yadi aḥadikum fasīla (nakhlatun ṣaghīra) fa-ini staṭāʿa allā taqūma ḥattā yaghrisahā, fa-yaghrish-hā
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: if the Hour comes while one of you holds a small palm shoot, then if he can, let him not rise until he plants it, so let him plant it.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: agar qiyamat qaim ho jaye aur tum mein se kisi ke haath mein khajoor ka chhota paudha ho, to agar ho sake ke utthne se pehle use laga de, to zaroor laga de.

dialogue.ar: فَالحَديثُ يَدْعونا إِلى زِراعَةِ الأَرْضِ حَتّى تَصيرَ خَضْراءَ، وَهَذا مِنْ أَحْسَنِ ما يَحْمي البيئَةَ مِنَ التَّلَوُّث.
dialogue.tr: fālḥadīthu yadʿūnā ilā zirāʿati l-arḍi ḥattā taṣīra khaḍrāʾ, wahadhā min aḥsani mā yaḥmī l-bīʾata mina t-talawwuth.
dialogue.en: The hadith calls us to farm the land until it becomes green, and this is among the best things that protect the environment from pollution.
dialogue.ur: Hadees hamein zameen ko aabad karne ki dawat deti hai yahan tak ke woh sabz ho jaye, aur yeh mahol ko aloodgi se bachane ke behtareen tareeqon mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ وَسائِلِ الحِمايَةِ أَيْضاً أَلّا نُسْرِفَ في اسْتِهْلاكِ الماءِ، فَالماءُ العَذْبُ قَليلٌ، وَقَدْ يُؤَدّي نَقْصُهُ إِلى خِلافاتٍ وَحُروبٍ بَيْنَ الدُّوَل.
dialogue.tr: wamin wasāʾili l-ḥimāyati ayḍan allā nusrifa fī istihlāki l-māʾ, fālmāʾu l-ʿadhbu qalīl, waqad yuʾaddī naqṣuhu ilā khilāfātin waḥurūbin bayna d-duwal.
dialogue.en: Another means of protection is not to be wasteful in using water, for fresh water is scarce, and its shortage may lead to disagreements and wars between states.
dialogue.ur: Hifazat ka ek aur tareeqa yeh hai ke hum paani ke istemal mein israaf na karein, kyunke meetha paani kam hai, aur is ki qillat mulkon ke darmiyan ikhtilafat aur jangon ka sabab ban sakti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَنْهانا الإِسْلامُ عَنِ الإِسْرافِ في الماءِ، وَلَوْ كُنّا في عِبادَة.
dialogue.tr: wayanhānā l-islāmu ʿani l-isrāfi fī l-māʾ, walaw kunnā fī ʿibādah.
dialogue.en: Islam forbids us from wastefulness with water, even if we are in an act of worship.
dialogue.ur: Islam hamein paani mein israaf se rokta hai, chahe hum ibadat mein hi kyun na hon.

q.en: Why must a person protect his environment, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq insaan mahol ki hifazat kyun kare?
q.ar: لِماذا يَجِبُ عَلى الإِنْسانِ أَنْ يَحْمِيَ بيئَتَهُ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

options: لِأَنَّها نِعْمَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ أَنْعَمَ اللهُ بِها عَلَيْنا
options_ar: لِأَنَّها نِعْمَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ أَنْعَمَ اللهُ بِها عَلَيْنا

q.en: Which way does Islam call to?
q.ur: Islam kis cheez ki taraf bulata hai?

q.en: What is also a way to protect the environment?
q.ur: Mahol ki hifazat ka aur tareeqa?
q.ar: أَيُّ شَيْءٍ مِنْ وَسائِلِ حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ؟

q.en: What can lack of water lead to between countries?
q.ur: Paani ki kami mulkon ke darmiyan kya kar sakti hai?
q.ar: إِلامَ قَدْ يُؤَدّي نَقْصُ الماءِ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ؟

q.en: What does Islam say about waste, even in worship?
q.ur: Islam israf ke baare mein kya kehta hai, ibadat mein bhi?
q.ar: ما مَوْقِفُ الإِسْلامِ مِنَ الإِسْرافِ حَتّى في العِبادَةِ؟

intro.en: A present-tense verb after لَمْ or لا (the 'do not' lā) is in the 'jazm' state. Its signs: a sukoon, dropping the noon (for the five verbs), or dropping the weak letter (for verbs ending in a weak letter). Example: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ (do not harm the environment).
intro.ur: Fe'l muzari' jab لَمْ ya لا (mana karne wala) ke baad aaye to majzoom hota hai. Nishaniyan: sukoon, noon ka girna (af'al-e-khamsa mein), ya harf-e-illat ka girna (jis fe'l ke akhir mein illat ho). Misal: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ (mahol mat bigado).
intro.ar: يُجْزَمُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ بَعْدَ «لَمْ» وَ«لا» النّاهِيَةِ. وَعَلاماتُ الجَزْمِ: السُّكونُ، وَحَذْفُ النّونِ في الأَفْعالِ الخَمْسَةِ، وَحَذْفُ حَرْفِ العِلَّةِ في المُعْتَلِّ الآخِرِ. مِثالٌ: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ.

q.en: The jazm sign of a regular verb like لَمْ يَلْعَبْ is:
q.ur: Aam fe'l لَمْ يَلْعَبْ ki jazm ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ جَزْمِ الفِعْلِ الصَّحيحِ في «لَمْ يَلْعَبْ»؟

q.en: The jazm sign in لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ is:
q.ur: لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ mein jazm ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ الجَزْمِ في «لا تُفْسِدوا البيئَةَ»؟

q.en: The jazm sign in لَمْ يَدْعُ صاحِبَهُ is:
q.ur: لَمْ يَدْعُ صاحِبَهُ mein jazm ki nishani:
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ الجَزْمِ في «لَمْ يَدْعُ صاحِبَهُ»؟

q.en: Which word makes a present verb jazm to negate the past?
q.ur: Kaun sa harf muzari' ko majzoom kar ke maazi ki nafi karta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ تَجْزِمُ المُضارِعَ وَتَنْفي الماضِيَ؟

q.en: In لَمْ يَفْحَصْ المَريضَ, how does the verb يَفْحَصْ end?
q.ur: لَمْ يَفْحَصْ mein fe'l ka akhir kaisa hai?
q.ar: بِمَ يَنْتَهي الفِعْلُ «يَفْحَصْ» في «لَمْ يَفْحَصِ المَريضَ»؟

intro.en: In this section you practise writing. First turn the dialogue of lesson 1 into a story, starting with a given sentence. Then write about 'Types of environmental pollution', using the reading text.
intro.ur: Is hissay mein likhne ki mashq hai. Pehle sabaq 1 ke mukaalme ko kahani mein badlein, di gayi pehli line se. Phir parhai ki madad se 'mahol ki aloodgi ki qismein' par likhein.
intro.ar: في هذا القِسْمِ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الكِتابَةِ. حَوِّلْ حِوارَ الدَّرْسِ الأَوَّلِ إِلى قِصَّةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِجُمْلَةٍ مُعْطاةٍ، ثُمَّ اُكْتُبْ عَنْ «أَنْواعِ تَلَوُّثِ البيئَةِ» مُسْتَعيناً بِنَصِّ القِراءَةِ.

q.en: The starting sentence of the story is about:
q.ur: Kahani ki pehli line kis ke baare mein hai?

q.en: What is the title of the second topic?
q.ur: Doosre mauzoo ka unwan?

q.en: «سَرْدِيّ» (in the instructions) means:
q.ur: «سَرْدِيّ» ka matlab:

q.en: Which text helps with the second topic?
q.ur: Doosre mauzoo mein kaun si parhai madad karti hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ نَصٍّ يُساعِدُكَ في المَوْضوعِ الثّاني؟

intro.en: Two last skills. First, copy a line of poetry in Ruq'ah script. Then learn that some words have an alif that is pronounced but not written, such as هذا and الله.
intro.ur: Do aakhri mahaarat. Pehle ruq'ah khat mein ek shair naqal karein. Phir seekhein ke kuch alfaaz mein alif bola jata hai magar likha nahin jata, jaise هذا aur الله.
intro.ar: مَهارَتانِ أَخيرَتانِ: اُكْتُبْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمْ أَنَّ في بَعْضِ الكَلِماتِ أَلِفاً تُنْطَقُ وَلا تُكْتَبُ، مِثْلَ «هذا» وَ«الله».

q.en: In which words is the alif pronounced but not written?
q.ur: Kin alfaaz mein alif bola jata hai magar likha nahin jata?
q.ar: في أَيِّ كَلِماتٍ أَلِفٌ تُنْطَقُ وَلا تُكْتَبُ؟

q.en: Which of these is an example from the list?
q.ur: Fehrist ki misal kaun si hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ هذِهِ الكَلِماتِ مِثالٌ عَلى ذلِكَ؟

q.en: Which script is used for the line of poetry?
q.ur: Shair kis khat mein hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ خَطٍّ اُسْتُعْمِلَ في بَيْتِ الشِّعْرِ؟

q.en: The poem line says the ship does not sail on the...
q.ur: Shair kehta hai kashti nahin chalti...
q.ar: يَقولُ بَيْتُ الشِّعْرِ إِنَّ السَّفينَةَ لا تَجْري عَلى...
